where_it_arises: Comal, fryer, oven, hot braise and hot liquids in the kitchen
planning_control_idea: Defined hot zones, protective gear, clear calling of hot items, first aid on hand
professional_requirement: Safety consultant and fire professional; local authority. Planning level only; not a safety plan or compliance claim.

where_it_arises: Prep stations, slicers, knives and broken ware
planning_control_idea: Training, sharp tools kept sharp, cut-resistant gear and a stated clean-up process

where_it_arises: Fryer station, oil filtering and disposal, water near oil
planning_control_idea: Trained handling, cooling before moving oil, no water near oil, fire suppression at the hood
professional_requirement: Fire professional, hood designer and safety consultant

where_it_arises: Wet kitchen and brewery floors, bar spills, patio rain, entrances
planning_control_idea: Footwear rules, drainage, mats, prompt spill clean-up, visible wet-floor warnings

where_it_arises: Cleaning and sanitizing chemicals in kitchen and brewery
planning_control_idea: Labelled containers, separated storage, training, safety data sheets on hand and eye wash planned
professional_requirement: Safety consultant, brewer and food-safety professional

where_it_arises: Cylinders, bulk gas, fermentation areas, cold rooms and keg handling
planning_control_idea: Ventilation, detection and alarm planning, secured cylinders, trained handling, restricted access
professional_requirement: Mechanical engineer, gas supplier, fire professional and safety consultant

where_it_arises: Entry into tanks, vessels and pits
planning_control_idea: Entry prohibited by default, written permit approach, two-person rule, rescue planning
professional_requirement: Safety consultant and brewer; authority guidance; not self-designed

where_it_arises: Bar, dining room, bottle handling, recycling and patio
planning_control_idea: Break-handling steps, safer ware where suitable, covered bins and a quick clean-up routine

where_it_arises: Bar and table service of beer
planning_control_idea: Responsible-alcohol practices, hydration and food, calm refusals, rideshare help, staff training
professional_requirement: Texas alcohol attorney, insurance broker and approved server training

where_it_arises: Falls, allergic reactions, injuries, disputes and medical events
planning_control_idea: Incident log, staff roles, first aid, calls to emergency services, post-event reviews
professional_requirement: Insurance broker, attorney and safety consultant

where_it_arises: Hood and fryer, gas equipment, electrical, brewery heat and dining areas
planning_control_idea: Egress planning, extinguishers, drills, clean hood and vents, defined shutoffs
professional_requirement: Fire professional, fire marshal and insurance broker

where_it_arises: Storms, flooding, heat and cold affecting patio, supply and safety
planning_control_idea: Weather watching, patio closure triggers, shelter plan, secured outdoor items
professional_requirement: Safety consultant and insurance broker; emergency management guidance

where_it_arises: Loss of power to cold storage, lights, POS and brewing
planning_control_idea: Backup lighting, cold-hold discipline, safe shutdown of fryers and equipment
professional_requirement: Electrician, fire professional and food-safety professional
